main_flow_steps: click confirmation link to verify email

inputs.constraints: at least 8 characters, not one of the 100 most commonly used passwords

expected_outcomes: account created
email verification link sent
account activated after email verification
account suspended after 7 days if email not verified

business_rules.description: email verification required for full account activation
business_rules.source_text: Email must be verified via a confirmation link before the account is fully activated

business_rules.description: unverified accounts limited to read-only access for 7 days
business_rules.source_text: unverified accounts can still log in but are limited to read-only access for 7 days

business_rules.description: account suspension after 7 days without email verification
business_rules.source_text: after which they're automatically suspended

business_rules.description: password length validation
business_rules.source_text: Password must be at least 8 characters

business_rules.description: password rejection of commonly used passwords
business_rules.source_text: reject the 100 most commonly used passwords

acceptance_criteria: user can sign up with valid email and password
user receives email verification link
user can log in with unverified account but only has read-only access
user account is suspended after 7 days without email verification
system rejects passwords that are less than 8 characters or are commonly used

main_flow_steps: Prorate charge based on days remaining in the current cycle
expected_outcomes: User is upgraded to Pro plan
Charge is prorated based on days remaining in the current cycle
User can access advanced features immediately

business_rules.description: Prorate charge based on days remaining in the current cycle when upgrading mid-billing-cycle
business_rules.source_text: Upgrading mid-billing-cycle should prorate the charge based on days remaining in the current cycle

business_rules.description: Downgrade from Pro to Free should take effect at the end of the current billing period
business_rules.source_text: Downgrading from Pro to Free should NOT be immediate — it should take effect at the end of the current billing period

business_rules.description: Block downgrade from Team-plan to Pro if team has more members than Pro allows
business_rules.source_text: If a Team-plan user downgrades to Pro and currently has more team members than Pro allows, the downgrade should be blocked until they remove members, not silently truncate the team

acceptance_criteria: User can upgrade to Pro plan and access advanced features immediately
Charge is prorated correctly when upgrading mid-billing-cycle
Downgrade from Pro to Free takes effect at the end of the current billing period
Downgrade from Team-plan to Pro is blocked if team has more members than Pro allows

expected_outcomes: Tasks and projects are created
Upgrade prompt is shown when project cap is exceeded
429 error with retry-after header is returned when rate limit is exceeded

business_rules.description: Free tier project cap
business_rules.source_text: The Free tier is capped at 3 active projects

business_rules.description: Free tier task cap
business_rules.source_text: 50 tasks per project

business_rules.description: Free tier rate limit
business_rules.source_text: API requests are rate-limited to 60 requests/minute for Free tier

business_rules.description: Pro/Team tier rate limit
business_rules.source_text: 600/minute for Pro/Team

acceptance_criteria: User can create tasks and projects
User is prompted to upgrade when creating a fourth project
User receives a 429 error when exceeding the rate limit

expected_outcomes: Teammates are assigned roles
Account owner can control teammate permissions

business_rules.description: Single role per team per user
business_rules.source_text: A user holds exactly one role per team

business_rules.description: Owner transfer restrictions
business_rules.source_text: Only the account owner can transfer ownership to another Admin

business_rules.description: Admin restrictions
business_rules.source_text: Admins cannot remove the owner

business_rules.description: Automatic ownership transfer
business_rules.source_text: If the owner's account is deleted, ownership should automatically transfer to the longest-tenured Admin

acceptance_criteria: Invitees can be assigned roles
Roles are enforced correctly
Owner can transfer ownership to another Admin
Admins cannot remove the owner
Ownership transfers to longest-tenured Admin when owner's account is deleted

main_flow_steps: use full Pro features during trial
automatically downgrade to Free if no payment method is added
expected_outcomes: full Pro features during trial
automatic downgrade to Free if no payment method is added
first charge occurs on day 15 if payment method is added

business_rules.description: trial eligibility is one-time per account
business_rules.source_text: Trial eligibility is one-time per account

business_rules.description: no charge until day 15 if payment method is added during trial
business_rules.source_text: the first charge should not occur until day 15, not immediately on adding the card

business_rules.description: automatic downgrade to Free if no payment method is added by day 14
business_rules.source_text: the account should automatically downgrade to Free rather than continuing Pro access unpaid

acceptance_criteria: user has full Pro features during 14-day trial
account downgrades to Free if no payment method is added by day 14
first charge occurs on day 15 if payment method is added during trial
user cannot start a second trial with the same verified email
ambiguities: detection method for trial eligibility (email match only, or also payment fingerprint) isn't finalized

main_flow_steps: permanently purge data after grace period

inputs.constraints: team-plan export includes only member's own tasks for non-owners

expected_outcomes: data is exported in machine-readable format
account is deleted after 24-hour grace period
data is permanently purged after deletion

business_rules.description: 24-hour grace period for account deletion
business_rules.source_text: 24-hour grace period during which the user can cancel it

business_rules.description: team-plan export scope
business_rules.source_text: a team-plan export triggered by a non-owner member should only include that member's own tasks

acceptance_criteria: user can export data before deleting account
account deletion is a two-step process
data is permanently purged after 24-hour grace period
non-owner team members can only export their own tasks

main_flow_steps: user selects notification types to opt out of

inputs.constraints: defaults to 9am local time if set, UTC otherwise

expected_outcomes: notification preferences are updated
digest emails are sent according to user's timezone
changes take effect for the next scheduled notification

business_rules.description: security-related notifications cannot be disabled
business_rules.source_text: security-related notifications (password changes, new device login) cannot be disabled

business_rules.description: digest email send time defaults to 9am local time or UTC
business_rules.source_text: defaulting to 9am local time; if timezone isn't set, default to UTC

business_rules.description: changes to notification preferences do not affect queued notifications
business_rules.source_text: Changing notification preferences should take effect for the next scheduled notification, not retroactively affect ones already queued

acceptance_criteria: user can opt out of individual notification types
security-related notifications are always sent
digest emails are sent at the correct time based on user's timezone
changes to notification preferences take effect for the next scheduled notification
